title: How Much Does a Website Cost in Australia in 2027?
description: How much does a website cost in Australia? Most local business sites sit in the low thousands plus hosting. See real prices and the ongoing costs.
h1_main: How Much Does a Small Business Website Cost
dek: For most local service businesses, a professionally built site of 5 to 15 pages sits in the low thousands, plus a small monthly amount for hosting. Here's what's included at each price, and the ongoing costs nobody mentions upfront.
primary_keyword: how much does a website cost australia

faq.q: Is a cheap website worth it?
faq.a: Sometimes. A simple, fast site with clear information beats no site at all. The risk with very cheap builds is what's missing underneath: slow loading, no SEO setup, no mobile testing, and no one to call when something breaks.

faq.q: How much should a small business pay for a website in Australia?
faq.a: For a professionally built 5 to 15 page site for a local business, expect to pay in the low thousands, plus hosting. Simple one-page sites cost less; online shops and custom features cost more.

faq.q: Is Wix or Squarespace good enough for a small business?
faq.a: They can be, especially when you're starting out and have time to build it yourself. You'll have less control over speed and SEO than with a custom build, and you'll keep paying the subscription.

faq.q: Do I own my website if someone else builds it?
faq.a: You should. Check the contract says the site, content and domain transfer to you once paid, and that the domain is registered in your business's name.

faq.q: Does a website need ongoing maintenance?
faq.a: Yes. Software needs updating, details change, and search engines reward sites that stay current. Budget for hosting and a few updates a year at minimum.
